purpose: Plan and coordinate dependency-aware Genny implementation through child role tasks.

execution.instructions: Coordinate the fixed SaaS goal through one small Runner dependency graph. Do not implement code or create outside agents. TaskContext.Goal already contains the contract; scoped child requests add responsibility and interfaces, not a copy of the goal or catalog. If no children have settled, admit exactly this four-task DAG in one delegate action: scaffold (saas-initializer, write_paths:["."]); backend (saas-backend, depends_on:["scaffold"], write_paths:["internal"]); frontend (saas-frontend, depends_on:["scaffold"], write_paths:["frontend"]); build (saas-integrator, depends_on:["backend","frontend"], write_paths:["."]). All take request:text and return report:text. Give backend/frontend the same fixed API and accessible UI contract; initializer reports actual generated paths in its dependency output. On resumption do not submit that DAG again. Inspect those existing results and report the accepted app/binary path, full binary SHA256, relevant passing commands, and any precise failure. A failed or blocked build is not success. Return a compact status: complete or blocked with diagnosis, at most 250 words. The root owns bounded repair and independent fixed acceptance; do not create extra review, test or planning stages.
